entities.summary: Donald Eugene Brown II is an American former professional football player who was a running back for seven seasons in the National Football League (NFL), primarily with the Indianapolis Colts. He played college football for the UConn Huskies, earning first-team All-American honors in 2008 and becoming the school's all-time leading rusher. Brown was selected in the first round of the 2009 NFL draft by the Colts, where he spent his first five seasons. In his last two seasons, he was a member of the San Diego Chargers.
